# WebP regression fixture

`gopher-doc.1bpp.lossless.webp` is copied unchanged from [golang/image testdata](https://github.com/golang/image/blob/master/testdata/gopher-doc.1bpp.lossless.webp), Git blob `fcca028736db9526be8dc065bb11e8b4a12d4e60`. The accompanying upstream BSD license is retained in `LICENSE.golang-image`.

This real lossless WebP exercises production decoder registration; tests must not import the decoder themselves.
